description: Make a spaced repetition schedule for a topic: every review date at expanding intervals from the day you first studied it, with any date on or after the exam marked to skip. Use next_review_dates when you want the next review date only. Dates can be plain text, like Dec 12 or in 3 weeks. Example prompt: "When should I review what I learned today for my exam on 2026-11-30?"

exam_date.description: Exam date, if any. Reviews on or after it are skipped. Use 2026-12-12, or plain text like Dec 12, next Friday or in 3 weeks.

first_study_date.description: The day you first studied it. Defaults to today. Use 2026-12-12, or plain text like Dec 12, next Friday or in 3 weeks.

intervals_days.description: Days after the first study to review.

name: make_spaced_repetition_schedule
title: Make a spaced repetition schedule
